profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer (.net/angular/vue.js)
profile.summary:
I have worked in software dev. during 1970s–1988 and 2011–present. I began my career in Holland as a programmer/analyst, developing administrative and financial systems.

Since 2011, I have worked as an independent full-stack developer, responsible for all stages of software development—from user requirements through production implementation. have worked with a wide range of technologies, platforms, and hosting environments including Azure, AWS etc.

I am experienced with Git and GitHub for version control, deployment, and production management. My client-side development includes Angular, VueJS, and Blazor, using state management tools such as RxJS, NgRx, and Fluxor.  Server side, I primarily use .NET with extensive experience in C# and the .NET ecosystem.

I have started working with Python, Jupyter, and Anaconda for prototyping. Used it for developing a video comparison tool to detect changes between original and edited videos, enabling automated transformation of captions and subtitle files.

I continually learn and adopt new technologies that help me rapidly deliver high-quality solutions for clients. My approach emphasizes sound architecture, adherence to accepted design principles, and maintainable code that can evolve over time. Documentation, both within code and externally, is a critical part of my process.

**Server Frameworks:**  .NET MVC/Core, Web API, Web Forms, NodeJS (limited), PHP 7, Azure, AWS
**Operating Systems:** Windows, Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS - limited)
**Applications:** NopCommerce, Zoho CRM
**Databases:** MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RavenDB, MongoDB (limited), LINQ, EF
**Languages:** C#, VB, VB6, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Python, Zoho Deluge
**Markup/Styling:** HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, KendoUI
**Front-End Frameworks:** AngularJS/Angular 14, VueJS, Ionic, Blazor WASM
**Source Control:** TFS, Git
**Tools:** Visual Studio (2017–2022), VS Code, WebStorm, Docker, Gulp, NPM, RxJS, Fluxor, NgRx
**Design/Methods:** Domain Driven Design, OOP, SOLID, DI/IOC, Agile (limited)

**Applications Built:**
From 1970s–1988, developed administrative and financial systems in Europe.
Since 2011, built numerous applications including:
– Gift management systems for large-scale events
– Corporate and LLC registration tools
– Metadata and upload systems for video platforms (iTunes, Hulu, Vudu, etc.)
– Webpage organizer and visual calendar tools
– Slider management and property inventory systems
– iTunes Extras metadata generator/uploader
– Video comparison and subtitle transformation tools
– Customized Zoho E-commerce system for air duct cleaning services

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description:
Tailor made a CRM system for a Duct Cleaning Company using Zoho CRM and its scripting language. 
Software built includes:  a dynamic Multi-User Organizer Web Page builder that incorporates existing media content (stories, art, film, audio etc.)  Highly-featured.  Built for a non-profit.  Dynamic  Slider Content Manager (contents are calendar driven).  Image based Calendar Management System that is theme driven and links to website content.  For the entertainment industry, managing the metadata associated with films and TV and generating the metadata required by the many platforms (iTunes, Amazon, Hulu, VUDU etc.) which includes the automatic upload of these titles to these platforms.  A metadata generator for iTunes Extras.  Inventory Management System to track and manage the personal property of individual clients.  A system to generate PDF documents related to the creation of Legal Entities.  A gift management application.  A phone application for understanding emotional tones, behaviors and attitudes.  A phone application that allows easy and managed access to multiple websites using internal-linking.
